item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-112250 - Windows Server
item.description:

Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.4
Resumo:
A vulnerability has been identified in BRAIN2 versions up to and including version 3.09. Under specific installation conditions, the password of a Windows service account may be written in cleartext to a setup log file. The issue occurs when Microsoft SQL Server access is configured using Integrated Security and the Windows account intended to run the BRAIN2 MainService is specified during execution of the BRAIN2 ins...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112250

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-110285 - WordPress
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-110285 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.3
Resumo:
The WP Stripe Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.2.2.62 does not verify the Stripe webhook signature when no signing secret is configured, which is its default state, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge a payment completion notification and create a completed order without paying.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-110285

item.title: [Infraestrutura] CVE-2026-116070 - Docker
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-116070 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Docker-Proxy through 5.1.9 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the hubcmdui routes/config.js that allows unauthenticated attackers to read and overwrite configuration via /api/config. Attackers can retrieve the WeChat webhook URL and Telegram bot token, and overwrite menuItems links, proxyDomain, and the monitoring webhook destination receiving alerts.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-116070

item.title: [Segurança] CVE-2026-116147 - Check Point
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-116147 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.7
Resumo:
ImageMagick before 6.9.13-58 and 7.x before 7.1.2-33 contains a null pointer dereference in the DJVU decoder because the result of a memory allocation is not checked before use. Attackers can supply a DJVU image that, when processed under conditions where the allocation fails, crashes the process and causes a denial of service.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-116147

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2025-15705 - WordPress
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2025-15705 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.5
Resumo:
The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.8.0 does not sanitise and escape a form name, allowing users with access to the form editor to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute when another user views the form. On multisite installations, where administrators do not hold the unfiltered_html capability, this crosses a privilege boundary.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-15705

item.title: [Segurança] Two Critical Wasmtime Flaws Could Let Malicious WebAssembly Modules Escape Sandboxes
item.description:
📰 Two Critical Wasmtime Flaws Could Let Malicious WebAssembly Modules Escape Sandboxes
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Two critical flaws in Wasmtime, a WebAssembly runtime that can be built into other software, could allow a malicious WebAssembly module to escape the sandbox intended to contain it, the project's maintainers say. An attacker would first need a vulnerable Wasmtime build to compile a module they control, and one of the flaws affects only ARM64 systems.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/two-critical-wasmtime-flaws-could-let.html
